title: Micah Blumberg, AI is the Sword of Revelation (April 1, 2025)
scope: Author publication consulted in full for its theological argument, predictions and metaphorical qualifications; not independent corroboration of its factual or scientific claims.

title: SVGN, News analysis: Trump's AI Fascism is taking shape (June 27, 2026)
scope: The author's published political-theological interpretation. The First/Second Beast passage explicitly uses an allegory; this edition does not independently audit every policy or product claim in the news article.

title: SVGN, Nuclear Deterrence Is the Missing Variable in Eastern Europe (March 1, 2026)
scope: Author publication and its prediction about incentives. It is not evidence of an actual nuclear transfer or a later refinery-to-famine forecast.

title: Revelation 13, World English Bible
scope: Primary scriptural text: two beasts, signs, worship, coercion and buying/selling. A modern identification is an additional interpretation.

title: Galatians 1, World English Bible
scope: Primary text: Paul's account of persecution, revelation, earlier apostles and a visit to Peter and James.

title: 1 Corinthians 15, World English Bible
scope: Primary text: received tradition, named witnesses and the statement that many witnesses remained alive.

title: Biblical Archaeology Society, The Egyptian Vizier Abdiel (June 1, 2018)
scope: Publisher's account of excavator Alain Zivie's research and interpretation of the name Aper-El; read in full. It explicitly does not identify the vizier with Joseph.

title: Alain Zivie, Pharaoh's Man, Abdiel: The Vizier with a Semitic Name
scope: Research article bibliographic record and visible endnotes consulted. Main article is access-restricted; the linguistic interpretation here is reported through the publisher's open account, not a claimed full-text review.

title: Israel Museum, Commentary on Habakkuk
scope: Curator Adolfo D. Roitman's indexed institutional description was retrieved. Direct page loading failed during research. The description says the Teacher, Wicked Priest and Man of Lies are not securely identified.

title: Joseph Blenkinsopp, The Midianite-Kenite Hypothesis Revisited and the Origins of Judah (2008)
scope: Research abstract and visible notes consulted, not the access-restricted main article. The abstract specifies the proposal's textual, poetic, Egyptian-topographical and genealogical foundations.

title: Jacob E. Dunn, A God of Volcanoes: Did Yahwism Take Root in Volcanic Ashes? (2014)
scope: Research abstract consulted, not the access-restricted full article. It combines a southern Midian setting with a volcanic reading of Sinai-Horeb; its existence is not proof of the identification.

title: Exodus 18, World English Bible
scope: Primary text: Jethro, priest of Midian, sacrifice and the meal with Aaron and Israel's elders.

title: Exodus 19, World English Bible
scope: Primary text: smoke, fire, trembling and the Sinai revelation; text description is distinct from a geological identification.

title: University of Chicago, World's oldest weather report could revise Bronze Age chronology (2014)
scope: Institutional account of Robert Ritner and Nadine Moeller's Tempest Stela research; consulted in full. A proposed connection, not a settled date for an Exodus.

title: Hendrik J. Bruins and Johannes van der Plicht, The Minoan Thera eruption predates Pharaoh Ahmose (2025)
scope: Open research paper: abstract and methodological discussion consulted. Multiple Egyptian objects are compared with Thera-context dates; authors conclude Thera predates Ahmose. This edition does not independently reanalyse the numerical dataset.
